title: STC-Net: Electroluminescence-Based Solar Cell Crack Segmentation for Power Loss Estimation
mechanism: Two fixed prior branches (Sobel gradient-magnitude pyramid and FFT radial high-pass residual pyramid) injected into the decoder of a U-Net-like crack segmenter, plus boundary-topology refinement and a crack-derived inactive-area proxy for power loss.
evidence: R: PVEL-S (840 train / 360 test polycrystalline cells): test mIoU 72.52, mDice 80.16, recall 83.18, precision 84.23. No ablation of the priors found in the text.
adaptation: Inject LoG (sigma about 1.5) instead of Sobel (Sobel fires on both flanks of a 4 px line while labels are 1 to 2 px on the ridge) and an FFT high-pass map into U-Net++ decoder stages. Use its inactive-area proxy for the severity track.
min_experiment: Arm: house + LoG and high-pass prior pyramids in decoder, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: test crack IoU, relF1@2, comp>=20 px recall. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012 and no relF1@2 gain.

alt_notes.adaptation: Feed Sobel magnitude and a high-pass residual as extra input channels to U-Net++, with the cutoff set above finger pitch or a notch removing finger periodicity so gridlines do not light up; auxiliary head on 2 px dilated crack rather than edge labels. Reuse the inactive proxy only as a severity baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + 2 prior channels + aux head. Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: test crack IoU, E1 crack recall. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and E1 recall < +0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Cheap form: 3-channel input (EL, Sobel magnitude, high-pass residual) at 512 px. Full form: prior pyramids into U-Net++ skips, edge head target = 3 px dilated crack label to absorb 1 to 2 px jitter. Aimed at low-contrast cracks (7% are < 2% darker) and E1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with priors (cheap, then full). Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: test crack relF1@2, E1 crack recall. Kill if relF1@2 < +0.01 and E1 recall < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Cheap arm: Sobel magnitude and high-pass maps as extra input channels to the house U-Net++; the inactive proxy is a simpler form of the crack-bounded region prior.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with 3-channel input (EL, Sobel, high-pass); baseline: house. Metrics: CV crack relF1@2 and crack IoU. Kill if < +0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Minimal: Sobel magnitude + high-pass residual as 2 extra input channels to the house model; full: prior pyramids fused at U-Net++ decoder nodes. Source-independent contrast cue aimed at E1, where 70% of crack pixels get p < 0.001; risk of false alarms on scuff streaks and gridlines.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house + priors vs house, 5 seeds; E1 crack recall and relF1@2, test crack IoU; kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and test crack IoU drops > 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Inject the two prior pyramids into U-Net++ decoder stages; replace Sobel with a LoG ridge prior (sigma about 1.5) because Sobel fires on both flanks of a 4 px dark line while labels sit on one ridge.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + LoG and FFT high-pass pyramids in decoder, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: test crack IoU, relF1@2, comp>=20 px recall. Kill: < +0.012 crack IoU and no relF1@2 gain.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use only the proxy, as a second post-processing arm next to PV-Vision. Fit the percentile and dilation radius per source, because BMRK and SDLE contrast differ. Do not adopt the network: its PVEL-S binary results say nothing about our 1-2 px jittered labels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same harness as PV-Vision. Arm: dark-in-dilated-crack rule ORed with model inactive, or ANDed with p(inactive) > 0.05. Baseline PF / PF ensemble. Metric: CV and E1 inactive IoU. Kill if gain < +0.02 or precision drop > 0.05.
